description: Pull the athlete's recent Garmin activities (last 30 days by default) and overlay them on the plan: activities are matched to planned workouts by date and sport (marking them completed with actual TSS, power, HR, distance) — a run that started within an hour of a ride finishing claims that day's planned brick — and unmatched activities are added as unplanned completed sessions. Re-syncing recomputes the TSS of activities already on the plan, so lookback_days is also the way to rebuild historic TSS after a threshold correction. Requires the Garmin Connect login to have been entered in the athlete's portal.

athlete_id.description: May be omitted when you coach exactly one athlete.

lookback_days.description: Re-read this many days instead of the default window (max 92).

name: pull_garmin_activities
